component.name: Nota
component.summary: Write and find local Markdown notes

description.p: Nota is a local-first Markdown note app for Linux and Windows. The native Linux app uses GTK4 and keeps your notes on your computer, with no account, telemetry, or sync service.
Write in a centered reading column, switch between Write, Preview, and Split, and open the Notes drawer to search your collection. Use tags and pinned notes to find what you need.
Restore notes from Recently Deleted, export local backups, or move a complete notebook between platforms. Preview and Split use WebKitGTK 6 in the Linux app.

screenshot.caption: Read a Markdown note in the Linux app
Write Markdown in a centered reading column

description.p: Native alpha presents the 1.0 Markdown Note App: Search, Tags with Edit tags and collection autocomplete, recoverable delete, paper-neutral About/help/confirmations, Backup Import Preview, Storage Recovery, Preview and 50/50 Split, and web-to-desktop transition restore. Collection data lives under the XDG application id net.astrazds.Nota. The first shippable native artifact is an x86_64 AppImage. Not a 2.0.0 release.
